About the Team

The Enablement Lead (EL) team enables organizations to turn OpenAI products into real, sustained impact through world-class enablement and training execution.

Our mission is to help customers successfully adopt and operationalize AI across their organizations. We partner with enterprises to translate the potential of OpenAI’s technology into durable capability—through structured training, technical enablement, and scalable deployment programs.

By helping customers move from experimentation to production, the EL team accelerates time-to-value, deepens product adoption, and helps make OpenAI indispensable to how organizations work.

About the Role

The Enablement Lead, Knowledge Work is a specialist post-sales enablement role focused on delivering high-impact enablement and adoption services across OpenAI’s product suite. This role is responsible for designing and delivering enablement experiences that support a repeatable adoption framework, driving sustained activation, expanding breadth and depth of usage, and measurable business value across OpenAI’s product suite, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Agents.

This role blends strong product fluency, instructional design, and customer advisory. You will lead live workshops, deliver services, and design adoption interventions for audiences ranging from everyday business users to technical practitioners and executive leaders, helping customers understand not just what OpenAI’s products can do, but how to apply them effectively in real world workflows.

Success in this role means accelerating customer confidence, increasing product adoption, supporting successful launches of new product capabilities, and helping customers translate product features into tangible outcomes across teams and business functions. You will own outcomes related to activation and sustained usage by shaping how enablement drives measurable customer impact.

This role is based in London/Dublin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

  • Own the enablement of OpenAI products, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Agents, helping define effective enablement patterns that support adoption across business and technical teams within enterprise organizations.

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for designated product areas, building deep expertise, supporting internal enablement, identifying emerging customer use cases for new product surfaces, and aggregating customer feedback to inform product development.

  • Lead customer enablement across the full customer lifecycle, from initial onboarding through expansion, optimization, and long-term adoption.

  • Design and deliver high-impact engagements, including onboarding sessions, advanced capability trainings, executive briefings, hackathons, and hands-on workshops for audiences ranging from senior leaders to working teams.

  • Drive customer activation, sustained usage, and measurable business value through structured enablement programs designed for durable, organization-wide adoption.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Solution Architects, Delivery Leads to drive adoption across our core product suite.

  • Develop and refine reusable training assets, playbooks, and best practices based on patterns observed across customers and regions.

  • Gather customer feedback from training and enablement engagements, synthesize themes across accounts, and relay insights to internal stakeholders to inform product and program improvements.

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for designated product areas, building deep expertise, supporting internal enablement, identifying emerging customer use cases for new product surfaces, and aggregating customer feedback to inform product development.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 6+ years of experience in customer facing, enablement, or instructional roles, engaging C-level, business, and technical audiences in complex enterprise environments.

  • Possess exceptional presentation and communication skills, particularly when translating AI capabilities into clear, practical value for senior and executive level audiences.

  • Have strong product fluency across ChatGPT, Agents, and the broader OpenAI ecosystem, with a practical understanding of how AI capabilities can be applied to real world workflows and enterprise use cases.

  • Have experience leading workshops and enablement programs, with the ability to design learning journeys, facilitate live sessions, and respond to questions in real time.

  • Can identify patterns across customers and translate them into scalable approaches that improve adoption across the broader customer base

  • Can connect product capabilities to concrete business outcomes such as productivity gains, operational efficiency, cost reduction, risk mitigation, or revenue impact.

  • Are comfortable thinking on your feet in live customer environments, adapting quickly to new information, shifting priorities, and real time questions while maintaining clarity, ownership, and momentum.

  • Bring a humble attitude, an eagerness to help others succeed, and a strong curiosity to continuously learn and deepen your understanding of emerging AI capabilities.

  • Are personally committed to fostering the safe and responsible evolution of AI.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

The Marketing team at Airwallex drives brand awareness and customer engagement through innovative and strategic campaigns. We work to communicate the value of our financial solutions, attract new customers, and strengthen relationships with existing ones. By leveraging data-driven insights and creative strategies, we ensure Airwallex stands out in a competitive market. Our team is passionate about telling the Airwallex story and supporting the company’s growth and success.

What you’ll do

You will own and scale Airwallex’s growth and demand generation content engine globally. You will work closely with global and regional teammates across Growth, Product Marketing, Product, SEO, Performance Marketing, and Lifecycle to build content that drives qualified demand, pipeline, and revenue.

This role is ideal for a hands-on content leader who loves writing and editing SEO content, ebooks, guides, and one-pagers, and who is excited to go deep on technical product narratives—translating complex capabilities into clear, compelling, conversion-oriented content.

You will join the Airwallex Marketing team during a critical period of growth. As we scale, we are building a team that balances global consistency in content strategy, quality, and process, with local flexibility and speed in execution. This is a unique opportunity to help shape how growth content drives the next phase of Airwallex’s expansion.

 

This role is based in London.

Responsibilities:

  • Build Growth Content Marketing as a global discipline at Airwallex, establishing best practices, scalable processes, and a high-performing team over time.

  • Own the end-to-end demand gen content strategy, spanning SEO, gated assets, mid-funnel conversion content, and product-led narratives.

  • Write, edit, and ship high-impact content including:

    • SEO pillar pages, cluster articles, and comparison content

    • Ebooks, whitepapers, and long-form guides

    • One-pagers, solution briefs, and product explainers

  • Partner deeply with Product Marketing and Product to translate launches, features, APIs, and workflows into content that is searchable, understandable, and sellable.

  • Use user, customer, and market insights to improve ICP targeting, segmentation, messaging, and content distribution strategies.

  • Work closely with SEO and Performance Marketing to align content with keyword intent, funnel stages, and conversion goals.

  • Be obsessive about measurement and iteration, using performance data to continuously optimize content for traffic quality, engagement, and pipeline impact.

  • Hold a high bar for content quality and technical accuracy, ensuring clarity without oversimplifying complex concepts.

  • Build a structured experimentation mindset—scaling what performs, refreshing or retiring what doesn’t.

  • Balance short-term growth outcomes with longer-term investments in evergreen content, topical authority, and durable demand.

Who you are

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 6+ years of experience in growth content marketing, demand gen content, or SEO-led content roles, preferably at a high-growth B2B technology company.

  • A proven track record of creating content that drives measurable business outcomes across the funnel—from traffic to MQLs to pipeline.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to explain technical products, platforms, or workflows clearly and credibly.

  • Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals, including keyword intent, on-page optimization, internal linking, and content clustering.

  • A data-driven mindset, with the ability to analyze content performance and optimize based on results—not just instincts.

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Product, SEO, Performance, and Lifecycle teams.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, global environment and communicating progress and impact to key stakeholders.

  • Experience managing freelancers or agencies and holding them to a high bar for quality and performance.

  • Familiarity with common CMS, SEO, analytics, and experimentation tools (e.g., Webflow/WordPress, GSC, GA4, Ahrefs).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in B2B, SaaS, or fintech environments.

  • Additional language skills (e.g. French, Italian, Spanish, German, Hebrew,...).

  • Good understanding of technical products.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

About the Role

You'll own a significant slice of the SINGU product suite: space management and Soft FM services – cleaning standards, portering, and catering – used every day primarily across the UK healthcare market. Product-market fit is established and thousands of users depend on these products daily. What the portfolio needs now is strategic direction and taking them to their next level of growth.

You'll do that through a team of four Product Managers who are domain experts in the products they run. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll stay close to customer problems yourself, you'll raise the bar on how the team discovers and validates work, and you'll have real autonomy to decide what's worth building – and to prove it works.

SINGU group grows both organically and through acquisition, and several of these products arrived with the companies that built them. You'll shape the strategy for bringing them into one coherent ecosystem and lead your team through that change. If you enjoy taking a set of good but separate products and making them add up to something bigger, that is the interesting part of this job.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, and Product colleagues across the SINGU Group so your portfolio drives revenue and solves real problems across the European FM market. AI is a must-have lever in our industry rather than a talking point: you'll be applying it where it measurably improves how our customers run their estates.

This is a remote position with periodic travel to London and Kraków – roughly every two to four weeks.

Role Scope

People Leadership & Team Development:

  • Manage and develop the Product Managers within the product team.

  • Own the full management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, mentorship, feedback, coaching, performance evaluations, promotions, and exits.

  • Foster a high-performing product culture based on customer empathy, data-driven decision-making, and outcome orientation.

  • Manage staffing and focus areas across the suite, reallocating product resources where needed to balance discovery workload and meet strategic priorities.

  • Lead the team through change – new ways of working, a shifting portfolio, and product consolidation – bringing people with you rather than around them.

Product Discovery & Strategy:

  • Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market trends.

  • Decide where to invest and where to hold: set a clear, defensible position on which initiatives scale and communicate it across the business.

  • Build strong alignment with the Sales team to ensure product discovery and roadmap priorities actively unblock deals and support revenue growth.

  • Identify and resolve ambiguities, dependencies, and competing priorities that impact discovery quality and speed.

Product Management Best Practices & Standards:

  • Promote modern product practices, including continuous discovery, outcome-based roadmapping, and hypothesis-driven development.

  • Ensure product teams consistently validate assumptions through user research, experimentation, and data analysis.

  • Drive improvements in requirements quality, stakeholder communication, prioritization frameworks, and release planning.

  • Cooperate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Managers to ensure product decisions account for technical feasibility and platform constraints.

  • Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools and analytics to improve product insights, customer understanding, and decision-making quality.

Collaboration & Cross-Company Coordination:

  • Coordinate with commercial and customer-facing teams to align product strategy with go-to-market plans and revenue goals for the portfolio.

  • Represent the company at external events, conferences, and industry forums to share product insights, build the Group's profile, and stay connected to market trends.

  • Maintain alignment, knowledge sharing, and team cohesion with colleagues across the Group.

Experience & Requirements

Must have's:

  • 5+ years in product management, ideally with at least three of them in B2B SaaS. Strong B2C experience in FM, healthcare, or an adjacent domain is also worth a conversation.

  • At least two years leading a team as a people manager – product managers ideally, but we are flexible on the setup; what matters is that you have owned a team, not that you are ready to start.

  • Experience taking a team or a product area through real change: new ways of working, a restructure, or post-acquisition integration – and bringing the sceptics with you.

  • Demonstrable experience applying AI within product development, using AI-powered tooling to accelerate discovery and delivery.

  • Proven track record of leading product discovery across multiple methods and translating insights into validated roadmaps.

  • Strong commercial awareness: able to partner with Sales and align product decisions with revenue and retention goals.

  • Data fluency: comfortable defining metrics, querying product analytics, and using quantitative evidence to drive decisions.

  • Excellent stakeholder communication: able to frame trade-offs and build alignment across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • English at C1 or above, written and spoken, with the confidence to represent the product externally.

Nice to Have's:

  • Experience working in empowered product trios (or similar cross-functional squads) with engineering and design.

  • Experience in healthcare (ideally the UK market, NHS), public sector, or government-adjacent markets.

  • Familiarity with platform or multi-product portfolio environments.

  • Experience integrating acquired products into a single coherent platform.

  • Polish or German alongside English.

Not sure you tick every box? If you are strong on product leadership and craft but light on one of the requirements, we would still like to hear from you.

Why Here

  • Real ownership: you own a portfolio and the team that runs it. Strategy, discovery, and outcomes are yours, not a backlog handed down to you.

  • Modern product culture: we work in trios, practice continuous discovery, and ship to learn.

  • AI that makes sense: you'll apply AI to a platform customers already rely on, where it measurably improves how they run their estates – not bolted on for its own sake.

  • A stable base for ambitious work: SINGU is profitable and growing, with consistently stable results.

  • Growth: SINGU keeps growing through acquisition, so new areas to consolidate and lead keep appearing.

  • International scope: five companies and around 250 people across Poland, the UK, and Germany, with a portfolio that spans markets rather than one office.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.
